Places an order for each item, on paper or live as the workflow trades: the copy Copy sizing worked out, or one of its own settings, at once or resting on the book. Filled orders go out of main, those left resting out of resting, those that did not fill out of missed.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `trading.placeOrder` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main`, `resting`, `missed` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Order (`from`) | text | no | `copy` | copy: the order Copy sizing worked out. settings: the order these settings make. One of `copy`, `settings`. |
| Token (`tokenId`) | text | no |  | For settings: the outcome's token ID. |
| Side (`side`) | text | no |  | For settings. One of `buy`, `sell`. |
| Price (`price`) | number | no |  | For settings: the limit, the most a buy pays per share or the least a sell takes. |
| Shares (`shares`) | number | no |  | For settings: how many to buy or sell. |
| Dollars (`dollars`) | number | no |  | For settings: a buy of so many dollars instead of shares. |
| Type (`type`) | text | no | `FAK` | For settings. FAK: what the book has within the price, the rest cancelled. FOK: all of it, or nothing. GTC: what the book has, the rest resting at the price until filled or cancelled. GTD: the same, until Expires after. One of `FAK`, `FOK`, `GTC`, `GTD`. |
| Copy as (`copyAs`) | text | no | `copy` | For copy: copy, as Copy sizing worked it out, a FAK. GTC or GTD: resting at the copy's price instead, what fills at once included. One of `copy`, `GTC`, `GTD`. |
| Expires after (`expiresAfter`) | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `1h` | no | `1h` | For GTD: how long it rests, 3 minutes at the least; then what is left is cancelled. |
| Post-only (`postOnly`) | true or false | no | `false` | For GTC and GTD: refused rather than matched at once, so it only ever rests on the book. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on with these fields added. Decimals are text, so they stay exact; times are RFC 3339 text.

| Field | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order` | object | The order placed, and how it went. |
| `order.id` | text | Its ID in the workflow's orders. |
| `order.mode` | text, one of `paper`, `live` | paper: simulated against the live book. live: on Polymarket, from the workflow's wallet. |
| `order.status` | text, one of `filled`, `partial`, `open`, `unfilled`, `refused`, `pending`, `failed` | filled, partial (the rest cancelled), open (resting on the book, filled in part or not yet), unfilled or refused; live, also pending (sent, its outcome not known yet: followed) or failed (matched, but its trades failed on chain). |
| `order.reason` | text; or null | Why it was refused or did not fill wholly. |
| `order.shares` | decimal | Shares it got or sold. |
| `order.dollars` | decimal | Dollars they came to. |
| `order.fees` | decimal | Fees paid, in dollars. |
| `order.price` | decimal; or null | The average price per share; null when nothing filled. |
